name: Third Descender
desc: A being from another world who opened the Abyss gates for the Belyi Tsar. He was slain by the Heavenly Principles, and his body was transformed into seven Gnoses.

customize.name: Descenders
customize.desc: Beings from outside of Teyvat, whose wills can rival an entire world.

customize.text: The Third Descender is an outsider whose will is capable of challenging an entire world. At the Belyi Tsar's command, the Third Descender and Anastasya Feodorovna opened the gates of the Abyss, which was deemed a crime by the Heavenly Principles. The Belyi Tsar escaped in the

customize.name: Shadow Realm
customize.desc:
A mysterious space that appears in Snezhnaya.

It is said to be inextricably linked to the golden city of Hyperborea, from which a splendorous civilization was once constructed.

customize.text: , but the Heavenly Principles erased Anastasya from existence. The Third Descender ascended to Celestia to negotiate with the Heavenly Principles and save her.

customize.name: Belyi Tsar
customize.desc: Monomakh Snezhnyi was the Tsar of all Fae and the first Cryo Archon.

customize.text: Before his death, the Third Descender left a seal that was kept by the Belyi Tsar.

customize.name: Tsaritsa
customize.desc: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya is the Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya.

customize.text:
The Third Descender sacrificed his life to the Heavenly Principles in a deal to resurrect Anastasya. The Heavenly Principles agreed, but erased everything related to the Third Descender from Teyvat.
The people of
are descendants of a bloodline that began with Anastasya and the Third Descender.

customize.name: Heavenly Principles
customize.desc: The First Descender, who defeated seven Dragon Sovereigns of the world and created people. The Primordial One may be Phanes.

customize.text: When the Third Descender went to Celestia for negotiations, he consented to have his remains split into seven pieces to consolidate the system of rule established by the Heavenly Principles. However, he placed a curse upon the Heavenly Principles, designed to trigger should they break their promise never to raise a hand against his descendants, the people who would eventually become the nation of Khaenri'ah. The Heavenly Principles ultimately violated this vow, triggering the curse and subsequently falling into a slumber.

customize.name: Gnosis
customize.desc: Gnoses are internal magical foci that each of The Seven possesses, allowing them to resonate directly with Celestia itself and serving as an emblem of their status. The Gnoses were created from the remains of the Third Descender.

customize.text:
The Third Descender possessed an unparalleled affinity for the power of Teyvat's Human Realm, and could even amplify the power of the various elements. He allowed the Heavenly Principles to transform his body into the seven Gnoses — internal magical foci that directly link the Archons to Celestia and enhance their abilities. These artifacts serve as cores containing vast amounts of elemental power, which the Archons can harness at their discretion. The seal left behind by the Third Descender reacts to the Gnoses, which is why the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya is gathering them to uncover the secrets it conceals.

Transcription Prism
A prism imbued with the power of the Third Descender, allowing it to circumvent the influence of certain laws of Teyvat. Believing that memories can be altered, Tsaritsa Anastasya uses the Transcription Prism to preserve her memories of each passing day.

customize.name: Exaiphanes Blade
customize.desc: A longsword that once shone with the Pale Star's light. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.

customize.name: Rhinedottir
customize.desc: An alchemist, a member of the Hexenzirkel, one of the five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, and Albedo's mother. Rhinedottir created an army of shadowy monsters, who attacked Teyvat 500 years ago. She's also known as Gold and R.

customize.name: Tsaritsa
customize.desc: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya is the Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>About Anastasya's past</color>
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : The only thing the Heavenly Principles erased from your mind... was the Third Descender and all memories related to him.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : And it wasn't just you. At that time, the Heavenly Principles used Irminsul to erase all traces of the Third Descender's existence from the world...
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : By fleeing into the Shadow Realm, only the Belyi Tsar was able to retain some memories of him. In all likelihood, what he told you was true.
<color=#36ffff>Tsaritsa</color> : It matters not whether those past events are true or false. As long as the Heavenly Principles are allowed to exist and have their way with this world, I choose to live in the present.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : Hm, is that so... Well, I have my own perspective, of course. I could share it with you if you were so inclined.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : After all, I once reviewed the records in Celestia concerning the Third Descender incident. It made for quite fascinating reading.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : First, as a Khaenri'ahn, I suppose I should pay my respects to you... "Mother of Khaenri'ah."
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : As I'm sure you know already, all Khaenri'ahns are descendants of a bloodline that began with you and the Third Descender.
<color=#36ffff>Tsaritsa</color> : I am aware, although I have no memory of it. I found out about it much later... I've just never known how to face you all.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : I don't blame you. In fact, I understand that sentiment quite well... as a "mother" myself.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : Maternal love is instinctual. But it's not an instinct that can be triggered simply by being told that one is a mother.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : Not to mention... The love that compels you as a god has been twisted and warped by the Heavenly Principles.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : You were forbidden to love those who were owed your affection. Instead, all you have left is the love the Heavenly Principles bestowed upon you.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : How unfortunate the people of Khaenri'ah were. We lost your love, and that misfortune can be traced back to the very incident in question.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : On that fateful day, the Belyi Tsar incited you — a mere herald of the court at the time — to open the gate to the Abyss alongside the Third Descender.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : This single act triggered the numerous Abyssal disasters that have plagued the world over the past millennium.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : It was, without a doubt, an unforgivable sin, but in all honesty, the true blame should lie with the Belyi Tsar as the instigator.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : However, at the time, the Heavenly Principles cared little for such details, and immediately erased your existence as punishment.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : The Belyi Tsar, on the other hand, escaped all consequences by fleeing to the Shadow Realm, and was never pursued further.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : Meanwhile, the Third Descender ascended to Celestia to negotiate with the Heavenly Principles, willing to trade his own life to bring yours back.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : There was something special about his physical constitution. He possessed an unparalleled affinity for the power of Teyvat's Human Realm, and could even amplify the power of the various elements. This is what he would use as his bargaining chip.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : As long as the Heavenly Principles agreed to resurrect you, and promised to never lay a hand on his descendants — those who would later be known as Khaenri'ahns...
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : He consented to have his remains be split into seven pieces to consolidate the system of rule established by the Heavenly Principles.
<color=#36ffff>Tsaritsa</color> : Then, he was naive. Attempting to negotiate with a higher being... Any promise made would be nothing more than empty words.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : Actually, he was more resourceful than you give him credit for. He had his own way of holding the Heavenly Principles to their word — a curse, profound and complex, one that would only take effect if the promise was ever broken.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : Of course, the Heavenly Principles had conditions of their own. They agreed to resurrect you, but everything about him would be forgotten...
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : After all, his power, his knowledge, his final acts upon this earth... They all made him dangerous in the eyes of the Heavenly Principles, and there was zero tolerance for such uncertain variables.
<color=#36ffff>Rhinedottir</color> : So, when the Cataclysm occurred in Khaenri'ah, it must have triggered the Third Descender's curse... That's why the Heavenly Principles are asleep.
<color=#36ffff>Tsaritsa</color> : I suppose that answers my initial question regarding the current state of the Heavenly Principles. Thank you for that.

textualResearch.title: Prayer Song XVI: Saarelainen, The Stranger of Winter's Day

desc.text:
O, let not the death-pangs you suffered pass into me, lover of frost and winter.
You cheerful, fair, kind-hearted lad, noble-born and nobly raised, a gentle and valiant son.
Upon the starry steed, you rode across the forsaken isle of Hiisi and the dark, mist-shrouded lands of Pohjola,
There to court the daughter of Pakkaisukko, that peerless beauty, at her home.
Then old Pakkaisukko, servant of our forebears, answered thus:
He will grant the young lady's hand in marriage if you should open for him the gates of Pohjola.
Cheerful, fair, kind-hearted one, you knew well that wicked scheme, yet you went forth freely.
For were you not to go, old Pakkaisukko would have his gullible daughter suffer the punishment instead.
In dark and foggy Pohjola, the Lord of the Seven Calamities carved you into seven pieces.
And that young and pure girl, the daughter of Pakkaisukko, shall never again be wed.
O lost hero, I call upon you by your unspeakable name, you the healer of the world's sorrows and misfortunes,
And may your grace still the wild winds of the frigid night and bring warmth to the young birds huddled on the frozen earth.
